description: Schema for one BuildX video library entry. Entries live in $BUILDX_PRIVATE_DIR/library/entries/<slug>.json (gitignored); this file holds no customer data.
title: BuildX video library entry

slug.description: Stable identity and filename. Lowercase kebab-case.

hookLine.description: The opening spoken line, exact words from the transcript.

transcriptPath.description: WhisperX <name>.words.json for this export, absolute path.

cutCount.description: Picture cuts in the export (PySceneDetect adaptive). Null if not measured.

graphicsUsed.description: Graphic types on screen, e.g. thumbnail-card, logo, lower-third, info-chip, plan-card, end-card.

captionStyle.description: Caption preset name, e.g. 'Thomas Default'. Null if uncaptioned.

performance.description: Filled in after publishing. Every value is null until measured.

retentionPercent.description: Average percentage viewed. Over 100 means the Short looped.

stayedToWatchPercent.description: YouTube Shorts 'Stayed to watch', 0-100. The hook metric.

exportPath.description: The finished export this entry was made from.

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp the entry was created.
